description: This file contains shell commands for testing the insertion and verification of iptables rules related to rate limiting ICMP echo-request packets, including rule insertion, verification, counters check, and cleanup.
calls: iptables -I INPUT 1 -p icmp --icmp-type echo-request -m limit --limit 1/second --limit-burst 3 -j ACCEPT
iptables -D INPUT -p icmp --icmp-type echo-request -m limit --limit 1/second --limit-burst 3 -j ACCEPT 2>/dev/null || true
